raw.rationale: IKK-2/IKBKB inhibition only weakly and non-selectively impairs viability in most adherent lines at 2.5 µM, with the strongest lineage-biased sensitivity expected in NF-κB-dependent B-cell lymphomas (not among the listed lineages) and modest effects in some lung, colorectal, and breast models; published PRISM-type screens show few, if any, lineages meeting the strict selective-kill criteria. Thus probabilities are low across all listed lineages, with slight elevations for lung, colorectal, and breast.
